name: Aclara Resources Inc.
summary: Aclara Resources Inc., a mining company, engages in the exploration and development of rare-earth mineral resources in Chile, Brazil, Peru and the United States. Aclara Resources Inc. was formerly known as 1303714 B.C. Ltd and changed its name to Aclara Resources Inc. in October 2021. Aclara Resources Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Santiago De Surco, Peru.
